skills.name: koreproject
skills.purpose: Manage project requirements, design statements and disposable project work.
skills.selection_description: Find project intent, propose statement changes, capture ideas, maintain hierarchical tickets and board placement, and add traceability links. Read before editing; use returned versions and ticket generation. Agents cannot approve statements or reset ticket storage.

tools.name: project_read
tools.purpose: Read project context. List records with pagination, or retrieve one record with links, comments and latest 100 revision/activity snapshots. Returns ticket generation for subsequent ticket writes.
tools.returns: Record detail or paginated items, total, offset; generation or explicit ticket_store_error.

tools.name: project_save
tools.purpose: Create or update one record. Common data: title, body, archived. Project: immutable key. Statement: kind requirement/design (immutable), state draft/in_review/retired, owner, section_id (matching statement/section kind; null means unfiled). Display refs use independent per-project sequences KEY-REQ-1 for requirements and KEY-DES-1 for designs, without leading zeros; use the UUID id for links and updates. Section: kind requirement/design (immutable, default requirement), parent_id (null for top level), position (nonnegative); named nested containers in independent requirement/design trees, separate from refinement links. Parent and child section kinds must match. Sections must be empty before archiving. Ticket: parent_id, lane_id (null for backlog), priority low/normal/high/urgent, owner, labels, position (nonnegative). Board: title/body; creation adds default lanes. Lane: board_id (immutable), category open/active/done/cancelled, position. Existing records require expected_version. Ticket/board/lane writes require current generation; sections use the durable definition store without a ticket generation. Use a unique request_id when creating to make retries safe. Content edits to approved statements become draft.

confirm_children.description: Explicitly allow moving a parent with unfinished children into a terminal lane.

tools.returns: Saved record including immutable id/ref and incremented version. Ticket display refs are per-project numbers such as GRID-TKT-101, starting at 1 without leading zeros. Show ref to users; retain UUID id only for API calls and relationships.

tools.name: project_link
tools.purpose: Link design satisfies requirement, same-kind statement refines statement, ticket addresses statement, ticket depends_on ticket, or relates_to. Rejects cross-project and cyclic dependencies/refinement. Ticket-related links require generation. Note can identify evidence URLs/code revisions; a link is not proof of compliance.

tools.name: project_comment
tools.purpose: Add an attributable investigation note or evidence reference. Ticket, board and lane comments require generation.
